caption: The video captures a foggy night street seen head-on, with wet cobblestones and embedded tram rails running into the distance. A single white sedan sits centered on the road with its rear visible, remaining stationary relative to the surrounding scene. Cool white street lamps glow on the left and center, while warm orange lamps shine on the right near a low wall lined with decorative posts. A broad hazy glow fills the upper sky, and the bright halos around the lamps fluctuate subtly as reflections shimmer on the wet pavement. Across the upper part of the frame, a thin overhead wire with small bright nodes drifts upward, its ends rising relative to the fixed background. This cable movement is the main visible change, while the car, lamps, wall, and road do not translate or change size. The view continues to show an ongoing atmospheric street scene marked by gentle light variation and the slow ascent of the overhead wire.
